digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync / hierarchy management
propositions: Two live cells asserted sub-task parent reparents (via fields.parent) that DC silently ignores rather than rejects, making them wrong oracles for an unsupported platform operation.

The emit-side suppression (_resolve_local_parent returning (False, None) for non-epic parent) was indistinguishable from 'unbound, retry next pass' and produced no durable signal, leaving divergence unrecorded and the bridge_alerts apparatus unreachable.

Re-homing the three cells from sub-task parent to Epic Link parent on non-sub-task children preserves the user-visible contract while targeting a supported mechanism already proven green in reconcile passes.
The outbound suppression must produce a durable operator-visible bridge alert when a bound non-epic parent diverges from the tracker, rather than exiting the pass with silent convergence.
All seven acceptance criteria verified green in live harness run 30964805133 after re-homing cells and wiring emit-time alerts for unsupported parent representations.
